Instrument.name: The Plasma Energy Analyzer (PM1) for Vega 2
Instrument.description: The Plasma Energy Analyzer (PM1) on Vega 1 and Vega 2 were identical. The PM1 instrument included six detectors: two ion analyzers; one electron analyzer; two collections to measure the integral plasma ion flux; and one sensor to monitor the integral electron current produced from its surface by photon and particle bombardment. The ion detectors were designed to study the energy distribution of the solar and cometary particles, rather than their 3-dimensional velocity distribution.
